moments.author: Ian Rapoport
moments.quote: Steelers G Mason McCormick suffered a dislocated ankle, no fracture, chance he’s back for the playoffs.
moments.why: Unexpected injury update gives hope to Steelers fans and playoff outlook.

moments.author: Ian Rapoport
moments.quote: Broncos and star CB Riley Moss have agreed to terms on a new 4-year, $67M deal.
moments.why: Secures a key defender, locking down Denver’s secondary and sparking huge fan reaction.

moments.author: WallStreetBets (via news quoting)
moments.quote: BREAKING: Anthropic prices IPO at $83/share after drawing nearly $500 BILLION in orders. $ANT begins trading on Nasdaq tomorrow.
moments.why: The biggest IPO ever, massive hype around AI stock—men 25–45 are obsessed with this market action.

moments.quote: Anthropic opened trading in the biggest IPO on record—shares spiked over 30% above the IPO price.
